title: Landing on a Mountbatten property seen by his gardener
summary: JASON tells of Landing on a Mountbatten property seen by his gardener, about unspecified at Mountbatten property, UK, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think there's a story that something landed on one of his properties. >> Wow. >> And his gardener saw it.

plain: A guest who goes by JASON tells on Jesse Michels's podcast of a story that something landed on one of the estates of Louis Mountbatten, a British aristocrat and naval commander. According to JASON, Mountbatten's gardener saw it, a detail offered to show UFO interest reaching into the British establishment.
